page_title: GEN 1-1 EMP | Genoa v Empoli 02/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+4' A free kick from around the half-way line will be taken by Genoa.
90+3' Davide Massa couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) and blew his whistle.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Empoli comes to nothing.

89' Empoli show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. Empoli have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
88' The ball is cleared after Christian Kouame (Empoli) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
86' Substitution. Ismael Konate (Empoli) on for Liam Henderson.
83' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) commits a rough foul. Davide Massa stops the game and makes a call.
81' What a goal that is! Johan Vasquez (Genoa) picks up a cross from the corner kick and fires a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box into the top right corner.

81' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball towards the top right corner. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Marco Silvestri with a fabulous save.
81' The ball goes behind for a corner. Genoa will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
80' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Empoli out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
79' Empoli couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Nicola Leali (Genoa) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
79' Liam Henderson (Empoli) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Davide Massa didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.

76' Ambitious effort from Maxwel Cornet (Genoa). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
75' Aaron Martin (Genoa) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
74' Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
73' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) is penalised for holding. Davide Massa signals a set piece.
72' Empoli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
72' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Liberato Cacace (Empoli). The ball goes out for a corner. Empoli can continue in their attacking effort.
71' Dangerous play by Jean Onana (Genoa). Davide Massa blows his whistle for a foul. Empoli have a free kick from a promising distance.
70' A long through ball into the box almost gives Christian Kouame (Empoli) a good chance, but he loses out to one of the defenders. The ball has crossed the sideline. Empoli are taking a throw-in.
69' Substitution. Mattia De Sciglio (Empoli) has come on for Sebastiano Esposito.
67' Patrick Vieira prepares a substitution. Patrizio Masini is replaced by Jean Onana (Genoa).
67' Substitution. Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Junior Messias walks off.

63' Liam Henderson (Empoli) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
61' Liam Henderson (Empoli) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
60' Corner kicks – 2:4.
56' Luca Marianucci (Empoli) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Davide Massa blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Genoa.
55' A substitution has been made. Mattia Bani is replaced by Stefano Sabelli (Genoa).
54' Mattia Bani (Genoa) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
52' Patrick Vieira decides to make a substitution. Alessandro Zanoli will be replaced by Jeff Ekhator (Genoa).
52' Fabio Miretti will be replaced by Maxwel Cornet (Genoa).
51' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 3:4. 0:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
48' Genoa seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
47' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
46' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Christian Kouame comes on the pitch for Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Empoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
45+2' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' The referee Davide Massa awards Youssef Maleh (Empoli) a yellow card.
45' Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa) receives a yellow card for infringement.
45' The free kick from long range, taken by Empoli, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
42' The resulting set piece from Genoa is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
42' The free kick from long range, taken by Genoa, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag and Genoa will take a corner.
39' Rough tackle by Johan Vasquez (Genoa). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
37' The foul by Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Davide Massa.
36' 0 - 1 Goal! Alberto Grassi (Empoli) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
35' Liam Henderson (Empoli) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
34' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
32' Junior Messias (Genoa) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is behind the touchline and Genoa will take a throw-in.
30' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Empoli.
29' A cross from Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Empoli will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
28' Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. It's a throw-in for Empoli.
25' Wonderful movement by Genoa. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
23' Liam Henderson (Empoli) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
21' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) commits a rough challenge and Davide Massa blows his whistle for a foul.
20' The game is interrupted now, Youssef Maleh (Empoli) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
19' Genoa can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
18' Empoli showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.

17' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) sprints into the box to get on the end of a cross and directs a shot goalwards that flies just over the bar. Unlucky! The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
14' A quickly taken corner by Empoli.
14' Empoli are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The ball goes out of play. Empoli are awarded a corner kick.
12' Saba Goglichidze (Empoli) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
8' Genoa are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
6' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) commits a rough challenge and Davide Massa blows his whistle for an infringement. Empoli have a free kick.
4' Junior Messias (Genoa) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.

3' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Genoa are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.

The players are out and the match is about to start. Empoli will have the kick-off.
Davide Massa will referee today's match.
